correctness.rationale: For every real lambda the cubic Hermite definition is unambiguous. Absolute summability of discrete jumps yields an L1-convergent derivative superposition and an exact step reduction; the step has three active cells. Outer variations are each 8|lambda|/27. The central quadratic derivative has sign fixed on [0,1] precisely for 0<=lambda<=3; otherwise its two roots and values give the stated closed piecewise formula. A literal unit step attains equality. Symbolic special values and standalone numerical checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The natural original four-tap cubic-convolution parameter spans a complete family of practical image/signal reconstructors. The result gives the exact universal variation cost at each tension, classifies the first creation of new central turning points at lambda=3, quantifies its fractional-power cusp and relates the accuracy-preserving lambda=1/2 case to a rigorous variation budget. The full-phase classification is not a cherry-picked finite-size calculation or restatement of one known special case; no claim of general image-dimensional optimality is made.
